description: This file defines a Flutter widget named PlayerIndicator, which displays the current player's turn or the game result (win/draw) at the top of a Tic-Tac-Toe game interface. It includes styling details and a sub-widget for displaying an indicator dot.

classes.name: PlayerIndicator
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that shows the current player or game result with styled text and indicator dot.

classes.name: _Dot
classes.description: A private StatelessWidget used internally to display a colored dot with animation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for PlayerIndicator, displaying different titles and colors based on game state.

methods.name: _Dot.build
methods.description: Builds the animated dot with specified color.
